facts.statement: SR University is established under the Telangana State Private Universities Act 2018, recognised under UGC Section 2(f), and holds NBA Tier-I accreditation for its UG engineering programmes (B.Tech CSE, ECE, EEE, ME and CE).
facts.source: Telangana State Gazette Act No. 13 of 2018, UGC 2(f) notification; NBA scope from SR University admissions presentation, 30 Oct 2026 (data/handbook/10_admissions_presentation_oct2026.md)

metadata.short: **NBA Tier-I** accredited B.Tech (CSE, ECE, EEE, ME, CE); UGC 2(f) recognised under the TS Private Universities Act 2018

facts.statement: SR University maintains a 6 to 6.5 LPA average package across engineering disciplines, with top offers reaching ₹51 LPA (Microsoft, Batch 2025), ₹49.30 LPA (ServiceNow, Batch 2027), and ₹46.38 LPA (Amazon, Batch 2026).
facts.source: Center for Student Services and Placements (CSSP) Official Placement Audit 2025-2027

metadata.short: **Placements:** highest **₹51 LPA (Microsoft)** and **₹46.38 LPA (Amazon)**; 1,300+ offers from 150+ recruiters

facts.statement: SR University provides 100% placement assistance and rigorous interview/coding preparation through the Center for Student Services and Placements (CSSP) and Career Guidance Cell (CGC). Individual job offers depend on student interview performance and skill clearance; offers are never blindly guaranteed.
facts.source: CSSP Placement Regulations Charter 2027-28

metadata.short: **Career support:** 100% placement assistance — training, mock interviews and internships through CSSP

facts.statement: SR Innovation Exchange (SRiX) is a DST-supported Technology Business Incubator hosting 171+ startups, ₹76+ Cr in funding, 14+ maker spaces, an IoT & ESDM lab, and a 3D rapid prototyping facility.
facts.source: Department of Science and Technology (DST) & SRiX Annual Report

metadata.short: **SRiX incubator** (DST-supported): **171+ startups**, ₹76+ Cr raised, maker spaces and prototyping labs

facts.statement: SR University hosts 11 interdisciplinary research centers, 14+ maker spaces at SRiX, and dedicated departmental teaching laboratories across all 6 specialized schools on its 170-acre campus.
facts.source: Academic Affairs & Dean of Engineering Infrastructure Directory 2027-28

metadata.short: **Labs:** 11 interdisciplinary research centres and 14+ maker spaces across 6 schools

facts.statement: Hostel in-time is strictly 8:30 PM for first-year residential students (with biometric roll call). For senior students, in-time is 9:00 PM on weekdays and 9:30 PM on weekends. Campus operates 24/7 security, wardens, CCTV, and an on-campus health dispensary.
facts.source: Office of Chief Warden, Student Residential Handbook 2027-28

facts.statement: Hostels offer 3-sharing and 4-sharing AC and Non-AC rooms (₹1,15,000 to ₹1,35,000 a year, room with meals; hostel fees are not on the 2027-28 fee circular and are confirmed by the Admissions Office). Hostel packages include 4 daily meals in the 4,000-seat Mega Dining Hall, Wi-Fi and round-the-clock maintenance.
facts.source: Admissions & Hostel Fee Circular 2027-28

facts.statement: For 2027-28, B.Tech CSE tuition is ₹3,40,000 a year, split equally between two semesters (₹1,70,000 each). Semester 1 of Year 1 also has the ₹5,000 enrollment fee, the ₹15,000 other fee (paid in Semester 1 every year) and the ₹5,000 Year-1 exam fee: standard Semester 1 ₹1,95,000, Semester 2 ₹1,70,000, first year ₹3,65,000. Tuition rises by ₹9,000 a year from Year 2, irrespective of scholarship. The application form fee is paid separately.
facts.source: SR University Fee Circulation: Official Fee Structure & Merit Scholarship Matrix, 2027-28 (fee_policy_2027_28.json)

facts.statement: For 2027-28, B.Tech in AI and Robotics tuition is ₹4,00,000 a year (₹2,00,000 tuition per semester), rising by ₹12,000 a year. Merit scholarships up to 40% apply to tuition.
facts.source: SR University Fee Circulation: Official Fee Structure & Merit Scholarship Matrix, 2027-28 (fee_policy_2027_28.json)

facts.statement: SR University awards merit scholarships of 10% to 40% of tuition (never on other charges): Intermediate 60–64.9% 10%, 65–69.9% 15%, 70–79.9% 20%, 80–91.9% 25%, 92–97.9% 30%, 98%+ 40%; CBSE/ICSE 80–89.9% 25%, 90–94.9% 30%, 95%+ 40%; JEE Main 90–94.5 percentile 30%, 95+ 40%; TG/AP EAPCET rank 1–2000 40%, 2001–8000 30%, 8001–20000 25%.
facts.source: SR University Fee Circulation: Official Fee Structure & Merit Scholarship Matrix, 2027-28 (fee_policy_2027_28.json)

facts.statement: SR University provides 20 special-category fee concessions from ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 a year (for example both parents not alive, international sports, children of regular SRU staff, disability above 50%, single parent, defence, sibling at SRU, students from Andhra Pradesh, girl child), subject to verification of credentials.
facts.source: SR University Fee Circulation: Official Fee Structure & Merit Scholarship Matrix, 2027-28 (fee_policy_2027_28.json)

facts.statement: Minimum marks (2027-28 fee circular): 55% in Intermediate for B.Tech CSE and ECE and their specialisations, 50% for other UG programmes, and 50% in the qualifying degree for PG (subject to confirmation). Meeting the minimum is not a guarantee of admission: admission is merit-based, subject to seat availability and certificate verification, and scores below the minimum are referred to the Admissions Office for verification. SR University never guarantees or reserves seats unconditionally for any score.
facts.source: SR University Fee Circulation: Official Fee Structure & Merit Scholarship Matrix, 2027-28 (fee_policy_2027_28.json)

facts.statement: Placement Leadership at SR University is headed by Mr. D. Sridhar (Head CSSP, stu.cssp@sru.edu.in) and Mr. G. Sunil (Placement Operations, SRiX 1st Floor).
